rules.supported: Evidence supports the stated responsibility or logical interaction.
rules.unsupported: Evidence establishes a deficiency; missing documentation alone is insufficient.
rules.not_applicable: The selected scope excludes this check; justification is required.
rules.coverage: Full: all applicable mandatory checks supported. Partial: supported and unsupported checks, none unresolved. None: all unsupported. Otherwise: undetermined.
rules.variations: Use the same criteria across configurations. Overrides require configuration-specific evidence; proposed rules are not automatically supported.
rules.proposals: Proposed rules and test passes do not establish historical baseline facts.

R7_proposed_logical_design.assessed_by: Assistant bounded proposed-design review; independent review pending
R7_proposed_logical_design.rationale: The proposed contract defines shared meanings: mask_fields removes named fields; filter_date_range uses inclusive date bounds; invalid or unsupported obligations block disclosure. T4 and T5 exercise failure handling and combined enforcement; T6 checks one C4 selection and C6 enforcement example. Support is limited to this proposed model, not historical baseline compatibility or general policy correctness.

R7_proposed_logical_design.assessed_by: Assistant bounded proposed-design review; independent review pending
R7_proposed_logical_design.rationale: Within the proposed flat-record model, authorization scope means an explicit allow-list of record IDs. C6 passes this scope and date obligations to C15. C15 restricts retrieval to allowed IDs and inclusive date bounds; C6 then applies masking and rechecks date obligations before disclosure. T7 checks this allocation including exclusion of an otherwise date-eligible unauthorized record. T8-T10 check denial, missing scope and empty scope. Scope correctness is an input assumption: its derivation from policy, consent or patient identity is not established. Historical baseline compatibility is not established.

assessment.assessed_by: Assistant documentary/scope review; independent review pending

R7_proposed_logical_design.assessed_by: Assistant bounded proposed-design review; independent review pending
R7_proposed_logical_design.rationale: Within the proposed flat-record model, C15 returns only records within the supplied ID scope and date bounds. C6 applies all supplied date filters before removing masked fields, then releases only the transformed result. No subsequent assembly step merges original records or restores removed fields. Invalid or unsupported obligations block disclosure without a partial result. Code review supports this restriction-preserving sequence; T5 and T7 provide combined-obligation examples. Support is limited to the modeled actions and trusted scope input, not arbitrary FHIR transformations or historical baseline behaviour.

proposed_rules.status: Proposed design only; not applied to assessed configurations.
proposed_rules.I2-RESPONSE: C4 supplies applicable obligations. C6 applies all supplied obligations and blocks release if any cannot be enforced. Policy-to-obligation completeness still needs assessment.
proposed_rules.I3-SCOPE: C15 retrieves within the authorized scope. C6 applies remaining disclosure transformations. This division is proposed.
proposed_rules.I4-DATA: C6 releases only the final restricted result and does not reintroduce removed data.
proposed_rules.script_boundary: The current script does not evaluate these proposed rules.
